question.nlq: Yo! I'm super interested in my team's build-up speed lately. Can you pull together a report showing whenever the squad sped up compared to their last measurement? I want you to rank the speed boosts from biggest to smallest and just hand me the top 5 updates for my specific club. Thanks a bunch!

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The first user is a devoted supporter of the team named 'KRC Genk'.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH SpeedChanges AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed AS current_speed,
        LAG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date) AS previous_speed,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed - LAG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date) AS speed_boost
    FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
    JOIN "Team" t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KRC Genk'
)
SELECT speed_boost
FROM SpeedChanges
WHERE speed_boost > 0
ORDER BY speed_boost DESC
LIMIT 5

turns.sql:
WITH genk AS (
    SELECT team_api_id FROM Team
    WHERE team_long_name = 'KRC Genk' OR team_short_name = 'GEN'
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT ta.*,
           LAG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date) AS prev_speed
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN genk g ON ta.team_api_id = g.team_api_id
),
boosts AS (
    SELECT date,
           buildUpPlaySpeed,
           prev_speed,
           (buildUpPlaySpeed - prev_speed) AS speed_boost
    FROM ordered
    WHERE prev_speed IS NOT NULL AND buildUpPlaySpeed > prev_speed
)
SELECT date,
       buildUpPlaySpeed AS current_speed,
       prev_speed AS previous_speed,
       speed_boost
FROM boosts
ORDER BY speed_boost DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH ranked_speeds AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        ta.date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date) as rn
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KRC Genk'
),
speed_increases AS (
    SELECT 
        rs1.date,
        rs1.buildUpPlaySpeed as current_speed,
        rs2.buildUpPlaySpeed as previous_speed,
        (rs1.buildUpPlaySpeed - COALESCE(rs2.buildUpPlaySpeed, 0)) as speed_boost
    FROM ranked_speeds rs1
    LEFT JOIN ranked_speeds rs2 ON rs1.team_api_id = rs2.team_api_id AND rs1.rn = rs2.rn + 1
    WHERE rs2.buildUpPlaySpeed IS NOT NULL AND rs1.buildUpPlaySpeed > rs2.buildUpPlaySpeed
)
SELECT 
    date,
    current_speed,
    previous_speed,
    speed_boost
FROM speed_increases
ORDER BY speed_boost DESC
LIMIT 5;

    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id

diffs AS (
    SELECT
        ta.date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed AS current_speed,
        (
            SELECT prev.buildUpPlaySpeed
            FROM Team_Attributes prev
            WHERE prev.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
              AND prev.date < ta.date
            ORDER BY prev.date DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS previous_speed,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed - (
            SELECT prev.buildUpPlaySpeed
            FROM Team_Attributes prev
            WHERE prev.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
              AND prev.date < ta.date
            ORDER BY prev.date DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS speed_increase
    FROM team_attrs ta
)
SELECT date,
       current_speed,
       previous_speed,
       speed_increase
FROM diffs
WHERE speed_increase > 0
ORDER BY speed_increase DESC
LIMIT 5;
